verdict.rationale: Convex's own docs list built-in file storage as a platform feature on Free and Starter plans, described as 'file storage for large objects'. Its general model of checking every public request against code-defined authorization rules could plausibly gate file access. However, the evidence only mentions file storage by name and never describes how upload, serving or file-level access control actually work. missing for 10: documented upload and serve flow (e.g. upload URLs or file serving endpoints), file-specific access rule mechanism, any evidence of CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.
